title: Erebuni are the Champions of the A-League 2024-2025 Season
description: Erebuni became the Champions of the A-League 2024-2025 Season. In the Final game they edged Urartu 105-78. Earlier in the Semifinals Erebuni overcame Lusavan 109-99 as Kenneth Miller (186-G-1995, college: OVU) stepped up with 34 points and Albert Tatevosyan (196-SF-1993) netted 31. Karen Melikyan (192-F-2004) replied with 26 points in a loss. Urartu meanwhile edged Artik 92-75 in another semifinal. Davit Khachatryan (210-F-2000) stepped up with 24 points and 18 rebounds, whilst Marat Mikaelyan (180-G-2005) scored 17.
